tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the recipe library. Dishes the selected diners cannot eat are already excluded by code; you cannot include them. tags are a preference that ranks matching dishes first, never a filter: pass tags only when the user names a characteristic. The request's time limit and recency filter always apply, and its query is used when you pass none; pass your own query to look for something else. Set max_time or exclude_recent_days only when the user asks for something stricter. dish_type limits the search to one type. Pass the ids you have already seen in exclude_ids to fetch the next batch. Returns up to 20 hits; each hit carries missing (required ingredients not in stock), missing_cookware (cookware the household does not own), uses_expiring (ingredients close to expiry it uses), and dislikes (soft dislikes it hits, by diner code). Hits with fewer missing items rank higher after relevance. In fridge-only mode only dishes with nothing missing are returned. Dishes using the ingredients the request names rank higher; when the request says every dish must use an ingredient, only dishes using it are returned. Also returns left_out_unknown_allergens (titles of dishes left out because an ingredient could not be checked), semantic_paused (true when meaning-based search was unavailable), unresolved_must_use (must_use names the dictionary does not know), and over_time_limit: dishes your query or the request's query names by their whole title that the request's time limit leaves out (id, title, time_min). They exist in the library but cannot be used under the time limit; never call them missing from the library.
